adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
adds.text: Back at the Lighthouse after his rescue, Fitz tells May that Izel is after the Monoliths, and they work out with Deke that the exploding Monoliths created Sarge.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Fitz briefs on what Izel is after.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who works out with May where Sarge came from.
adds.evidence: In "Leap" (S6#10), Fitz tells May that Izel wanted the Monoliths; Deke reminds May the explosion opened the Fear Dimension, and Fitz theorizes a creation Monolith made Sarge.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
adds.text: Piper flies with May's team to the temple to stop Izel, and May orders her to stay behind and repair the crippled Zephyr for extraction.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent May leaves to repair the Zephyr on the mission against Izel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Piper's commander on the mission to stop Izel.
adds.evidence: In "The Sign" (S6#12), May, Daisy, Sarge and Piper take a Quinjet to the temple; finding the Zephyr crippled, May orders Piper to stay and repair it for extraction. In S6#11 the two also discuss Daisy's plan for Sarge and find Benson.
